landsatexplorer.title: Esri | Landsat Explorer
landsatexplorer.description: Explore and begin to unlock the wealth of information provided by Landsat through an intuitive user experience leveraging a variety of ArcGIS capabilities.

landcoverexplorer.title: Esri | Sentinel-2 Land Cover Explorer
landcoverexplorer.description: This application displays the land use/land cover (LULC) timeseries layer derived from ESA Sentinel-2 imagery at 10m resolution.

sentinel1explorer.title: Esri | Sentinel-1 Explorer
sentinel1explorer.description: Explore and begin to unlock the wealth of information provided by Sentinel-1 through an intuitive user experience leveraging a variety of ArcGIS capabilities.

sentinel2explorer.title: Esri | Sentinel-2 Explorer
sentinel2explorer.description: Explore and begin to unlock the wealth of information provided by Sentinel-2 through an intuitive user experience leveraging a variety of ArcGIS capabilities.

spectralsampler.title: Spectral Sampler
spectralsampler.description: A streamlined web app for collecting and organizing training data for land cover classification with multispectral satellite imagery. Ideal for researchers, analysts, and students building high-quality reference datasets.

nlcdlandcoverexplorer.title: Esri | NLCD Land Cover Explorer
nlcdlandcoverexplorer.description: This app lets you explore and compare annual NLCD Land Cover data, highlighting dynamic changes through visual and statistical insights.

disasterimageryexplorer.title: Esri | Disaster Imagery Explorer
disasterimageryexplorer.description: This app provides timely and accessible imagery to aid first responders in accelerating humanitarian response and recovery.

dmcexplorer.title: DMC III 航攝影像探索
dmcexplorer.description: 探索並瀏覽 DMC III 航空攝影影像服務。

fs8explorer.title: 福衛八號影像探索
fs8explorer.description: 探索並瀏覽福衛八號（FORMOSAT-8）衛星影像服務。

unifiedexplorer.title: 航太影像探索
unifiedexplorer.description: 統一探索 DMC III、福衛八號與 Sentinel-2 衛星及航攝影像。
